If an MP3 player is randomly selected from this shipment, what is the probability that it is defective?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>Choice A is correct. The probability of randomly selecting a defective MP3 player from the shipment is equal to the number of defective MP3 players divided by the total number of MP3 players in the shipment. Therefore, the probability is \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"4 over 1,000\">\x3C/span>, which is equivalent to 0.004.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Choice B is incorrect because 0.04 represents 4 defective MP3 players out of 100 rather than out of 1,000. Choice C is incorrect because 0.4 represents 4 defective MP3 players out of 10 rather than out of 1,000. Choice D is incorrect.
